definitions.short: Cheptsi-bah , a fanciful name for Palestine
definitions.full: H2657. Chephtsi -bah חֶפְצִיבָֿהּ proper name, feminine ( my delight is in her ; compare Phoenician חפצבעל ) — 1 mother of king Manasseh 2Kin 21:1 . 2 figurative name of Zion Isa 62:4 , here explained by בָּךְ יהוה חפץ כִּי for Yahweh delighteth in thee .
definitions.rootNote: from 2656 with suffixes; my delight (is) in her ;
